location_exception_reason: Office Containers are industrial/commercial prefabricated structures sold nationwide; location origin does not affect buyer decision or product function. No GI protection or regional designation applies.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) in titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Office Container Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title.
